name: 360 ONE WAM Ltd
about: IIFL Wealth Management Limited, founded in 2008, is one of the largest private wealth management firms in India. The company mainly acts as wealth manager and provides services relating to financial products distribution, advisory, portfolio management services by mobilizing funds and assets of various classes of investors including High Networth Individuals. [1][2]
keyPoints:
Segment[1]
Wealth Management - Discretionary/Non-Discretionary Advisory, Lending Solutions, estate planning, Financial product distribution, Transaction and Product distribution, Corporate Treasury Services, etc. It has ~7200 clients. It also has an HNI segment of Rs. 5 Crs - 25 Crs.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 39.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 157%
cons: Stock is trading at 4.81 times its book value
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 89.6% of their holding.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -16.9%
